verdict.rationale: Cognee is explicitly open source and documented to run entirely self-hosted: docker deployment ('docker run ... cognee/cognee:main'), a local UI via `cognee.start_ui()` with no account required, and a pricing page stating 'Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever.' This covers core engine, UI, and pipelines running fully on one's own infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a full self-hosted deployment beyond vendor docs (community evidence discusses architecture concerns but doesn't test self-hosting itself).
